item.title: Keanu Reeves Officially Returning as John Wick in New Movie
item.description: Though John Wick seemingly met his end in John Wick: Chapter 4 , Keanu Reeves isn't done with his stylish assassin character just yet. A fifth John Wick live-action movie is in development, and director Chad Stahelski is also working on an animated prequel film . Now, Reeves is officially confirmed to return for it.

item.title: Stranger Things Officially Returns in 2028 With New Series
item.description: Netflix is bringing back Stranger Things in 2028 with a new live-action series, the company announced Friday. The new series, titled Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure , will take the sci-fi franchise to a new location and a new time period, and will logically feature a new cast of characters contending with supernatural terrors.

item.title: Magic's Star Trek Already Feels a Lot More Frustrating than Reality Fracture
item.description: A mere six weeks have passed since the release of Reality Fracture , one of the best-received Magic: The Gathering sets in recent years, and players are already primed to enter warp speed with Star Trek . Universes Beyond sets always get their fair share of criticism, and while it’s understandable that not every Magic player is attracted by Star Trek ’s unique aesthetic, the most important question for Limited players is: How does the set actually play?

item.title: Right Now Is the Perfect Time to Play the Quietly Best Yakuza Spinoff
item.description: When Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name was released in 2023, the Yakuza series was in a strange position. The team at Sega's Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio was gearing up to give a heroic sendoff to longtime protagonist Kazuma Kiryu. They had big plans for 2024's Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth to pass the torch to a new main character. But Yakuza had unexpectedly become bigger than ever outside Japan, thanks largely to the viral success of Yakuza 0 throughout the late 2010s and early 2020s. The fans demanded more Kiryu, not less. And developer Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio rose to the occasion with The Man Who Erased His Name , an interquel that depicts his lonely years in exile after the events of Yakuza 6.

item.title: Netflix’s Animated Twilight Adaptation Confirmed for Two Seasons
item.description: Love it or hate it, you've probably encountered the Twilight series at some point in your life. And the popularity of the vampire romantic drama is not over yet: Netflix is taking Midnight Sun , a 2020 novel that retells Twilight from Edward Cullen's perspective, and turning it into an animated series. It is now confirmed that the Midnight Sun adaptation will be a two-season series.

item.title: 25 Years Later, Buffy's Riskiest Episode Is Still a Brilliant Masterpiece That Changed the Show Forever
item.description: “ Once More, With Feeling” isn't just a great musical (although it is) or a great episode of Buffy (it's also that). The brilliance of this 50-minute spectacle is how it combines the two, using a demon's curse that forces everyone in the town of Sunnydale to sing and dance as if they were in a Broadway play to push the show's overarching plot forward in numerous ways.

item.title: It's Official: The PlayStation Blackout Protest Did Nothing
item.description: Disgruntled players tried to boycott Sony in August after the company announced it would discontinue physical media. However, it seems that the PlayStation Digital Blackout protest was a bust . Sony released official data for its second fiscal quarter, making it clear the boycott didn't move the needle. Instead, the company continued to grow, proving its point that losing physical media will not affect Sony as a business .

item.title: Tim Burton's Forgotten 10/10 Fantasy Masterpiece is Officially Still Free on Streaming
item.description: When the conversation turns to Tim Burton ’s best movies , the same titles tend to surface: Beetlejuice , his Batman movies , Edward Scissorhands , Ed Wood , and Pee-Wee’s Big Adventure . Even The Nightmare Before Christmas usually gets a mention, despite being directed by Henry Selick . Less likely to enter the discussion is Big Fish , Burton’s 2003 fantasy about a father whose life sounds too extraordinary to believe. That’s a shame, because it’s some of his very best work. It's also available to stream for free right now on YouTube and Tubi.

item.title: 49 Years Later, Steven Spielberg’s Sci-Fi Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Free on YouTube
item.description: Most creators are lucky if they ever make one truly revolutionary thing in their lives. Steven Spielberg has made at least six.
